plugin.name: rounded-corners
plugin._long: Rounded window corners with an optional plain border and soft shadows that follow the rounded outline. Replaces the decoration plugin's frame, do not enable both.

option.name: radius
option._long: Radius of the rounded corners in pixels. 0 disables rounding.

option.name: border_enabled
option._long: Draw a border around the window. It is painted outside of the window and follows the rounded corners.

option.name: border_size
option._long: Thickness of the border in pixels.

option.name: active_border_color
option._long: Border color of the focused window.

option.name: border_on_client_decorated
option._long: Also draw the border around windows that draw their own decorations (GTK, libadwaita...).

option.name: shadow_enabled
option._long: Draw a soft shadow around the window. Do not combine with another shadow plugin.

option.name: shadow_radius
option._long: Blur radius of the shadow in pixels.

option.name: shadow_offset_x
option._long: Horizontal offset of the shadow in pixels.

option.name: shadow_offset_y
option._long: Vertical offset of the shadow in pixels.

option.name: shadow_color
option._long: Shadow color of the focused window.

option.name: shadow_on_client_decorated
option._long: Also draw the shadow under windows that draw their own decorations (they usually already have one).
